Perform a variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) on BiFeO3 using LDA pseudopotentials, followed by a self-consistent field (SCF) calculation on the relaxed structure.
Use the following LDA pseudopotential files: PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/bi.upf, PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/fe.upf, and PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/o.upf.
The starting structure is a rhombohedral perovskite BiFeO3 with space group R3c and 10 atoms per primitive cell (2 formula units: 2 Bi, 2 Fe, 6 O).
Construct the starting structure using literature-consistent lattice parameters for R3c BiFeO3 (approximately a ≈ 5.58 Å, c ≈ 13.86 Å in the rhombohedral setting) and appropriate fractional atomic coordinates consistent with the R3c Wyckoff positions.
Set the electronic convergence threshold conv_thr to 1.0e-8 (Ry), the total-energy convergence threshold etot_conv_thr to 1.0e-8 (Ry), and the force convergence threshold forc_conv_thr to 1.0e-7 (Ry/bohr).
Set the wavefunction energy cutoff ecutwfc to 50 Ry.
Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift; choose the grid size as 4x4x4.
The vc-relax step must optimize both the cell vectors and the atomic positions simultaneously.
After the vc-relax converges, run a separate SCF calculation on the fully relaxed structure using the same pseudopotentials, ecutwfc, k-point grid, and convergence thresholds.
Return the fully relaxed atomic structure (cell vectors and fractional coordinates) and the final SCF total energy in Ry.
